id_reservations.note: Flow ids are the name-derived ids we expect (name with underscores + _A00); the platform assigns the real ids, read back after generate. List ids carry NO _A00 suffix so display names stay clean (A2 L35). Role ids are stable IR slugs; live role _ids are read back. Step ids are prefixed per flow (CASE_, OPNT_, CHRQ_) so they can't collide with field ids such as OP_Key or CR_Key.

CIQ_Case_A00.lane_prefix: <D>_ for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM
CIQ_Case_A00.rule: v4 names first (L197-L206, L189, L191), then PART D L733-L782 where it agrees with v4. Material fields are plain Text on the case (no CIQ Raw Material, L132). Contacts are fields, never a child table (L330). Gate and hold counts are plain Number fields written by the acting person's Workbench (A2 L32-L33, e.g. Open_Items_Count, Open_CR_Count, <D>_Open_Count, <D>_RMES_Gaps) read by blank-safe formulas; no aggregates. The step-condition fields above are reserved.

CIQ_Open_Point_A00.rule: v4 L244-L251, then PART D L887-L912 where it agrees (one item per point, not per round). Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Rounds columns use the Rounds_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Change_Request_A00.prefix: CR_ for identity and outcome; Impact_<D> and <D>_ assessment fields for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS
CIQ_Change_Request_A00.rule: v4 L267-L272, then PART D L957-L966. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Y6 fills the case keys it has (Case_Code, Cycle_No); RMM sets Case_Item_Id at Triage.

CIQ_Supplier_A00.rule: v4 L278, then PART D L1109. Contacts columns use the Contacts_ prefix (A2 L31). Never 'Country': use Supplier_Country_Code.

CIQ_Config_Version_A00.prefix: Config_ for version fields; Release_ for Release-row fields
CIQ_Config_Version_A00.rule: v4 L279, then PART D L1140 and the Release fields of PART D P5 (L1043-L1048), which v4 folds into Release rows.

CIQ_Section_A00.rule: v4 L280 and the X2 set 1:1 with the portal CIQP Section (PART C), then PART D L991-L1012. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Components columns use the Components_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Scope_Run_A00.rule: v4 L281, then PART D L1067. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent).

CIQ_RMES_Safety_A00.rule: v4 L282: one row per case keyed by the case's RMES_Key, a Reference to the case (Result_Case, PART D L1166), header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings), the lock. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Criteria columns use Criteria_, Findings columns use Findings_ (A2 L31).

CIQ_RMES_Regulatory_A00.rule: Same schema as CIQ RMES Safety (v4 L283).

CIQ_Internal_Note_A00.rule: v4 L284, then PART D L1199 (Note_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Linked_Kind, Linked_Key, Note_Text, Note_Author, Note_Dept, Note_At).

CIQ_Audit_Event_A00.rule: v4 L285, then PART D L1092-L1097. Notification and delegation fields included (categories L285).

global_field_rules: Never author Name; never name a field Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; owner-prefix generic words (A2 L41-L42).
No aggregates of any kind (A2 L32). Gates and holds: plain Number count fields plus blank-safe formulas; a blank count holds and never deadlocks (A2 L33-L34).
A child column never reuses a header field id: prefix it with its table's column_id_prefix, same label (A2 L31).
A field an integration copies has the same type as its portal counterpart (Text, Number, Date, DateTime, Email), never a Select (PART D L733).
Fields beyond v4 only where PART D gives field-level detail that agrees with v4, or where PART A requires them (Number count fields for gates).

domain.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire. RMM creates a case for a supplier raw material, receives basic data from the supplier (portal), runs the scope rules and releases sections, obtains the PS-05 completeness confirmation, then the active departments (Regulatory, Safety, QM, Microbiology, Sustainability, optionally RMM) review in parallel, raising open points with the supplier and (Safety, Regulatory) filling one RMES sheet each. Open-items checks and an optional overall approval precede the single PS-11 final release; the end produces a PDF. Supplier change requests are triaged by RMM and assessed in parallel. v4 model: 11 flows (3 Processes, 8 Data Forms) with child tables Contacts, Components, Criteria, Findings, Rounds; 11 custom roles plus Admin/User; the supplier acts only in the separate portal. PART A rules bind: no aggregates (Number count fields + blank-safe formulas), no pages, exact step names, intra-app automations Z1–Z4 only.

business_rules.statement: A Process is used only when the record moves through steps that carry SLAs (built-in SLA notifications); otherwise a Data Form. No process without steps.

No extra records: repeated detail lives in a child table inside its parent (or fields on the parent) when one writer, no integration on rows, few bounded rows and no cross-case search all hold; otherwise its own record.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L24; brd.md L96; brd.md L105-L111

business_rules.statement: Exactly 11 flows: 3 Processes (CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request) and 8 Data Forms; dropped entities (Raw Material, Case Contact, Supplier Contact, Component, Config Release, per-round items, per-criterion RMES rows) are not reintroduced.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L13; brd.md L115; brd.md L131-L138

business_rules.statement: Use parallel steps where Kissflow supports them: Part 2 review on the case and Assess impact on the change request.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L25; brd.md L188; brd.md L271

business_rules.statement: Child-table step permissions name the child table only, never its columns.
A child-table column never reuses a header field id; it gets a prefixed id (e.g. Rounds_Round_No).
No native aggregates are authored. Gates and holds use plain Number count fields written by the acting person's Workbench at their own step, read by server-side formulas.
Gate and hold formulas are blank-safe: a blank count holds and never deadlocks.
List ids are authored without the _A00 suffix.

Only intra-app automations are modelled: Z1 (case completed → PDF, e-mails, notification event), Z2 (case rejected/cancellation → neutral e-mail), Z3/Z4 (SLA breach on CIQ Case / CIQ Open Point → audit event). They come out incomplete and are finished over REST.
Cross-container integrations X1–X6 and Y1/Y3–Y6 are documentation only (the portal session builds them); no automation points at a portal flow.
No field is named Name, Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; generic words are owner-prefixed.
Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step names are exact (en-dash U+2013 where shown): 'Waiting for supplier: basic data', 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05', 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11', 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review', 'Review – Regulatory/Safety/QM/Microbiology/Sustainability/RMM', 'Open items check – before release request', 'Overall approval', 'Open items check – before close'; Open Point 'Waiting for supplier'; Change Request 'Triage' then parallel 'Assess impact' with 'Assess – Regulatory' … 'Assess – Sustainability'. The portal triggers on these names.
Editable on a Process also grants item creation, and flow Admin cannot be expressed; both are fixed over REST after generate.
No pages are added (backend only, --no-pages): a page auto-grant turns readers into editors.
The account key cannot act after Start; every human step is done by a person (Workbench or native), never by the sync service.
CIQ Sync Service is in scope: close sweep, snapshots, X2/X3 fallback, single-writer audit, component rebuild, PDF renderer (option A).
Overall approval, when switched on, comes before the PS-11 release request.
Safety and Regulatory reviewers record their internal RMES decision themselves; no separate approver roles.
No four-eyes on configuration releases.
The audit trail is claimed as 'tamper-evident'.
Roles are exactly the 11 custom roles plus the defaults Admin and User.
Never model, reference or write portal (CIQP) flows or the 'CIQ ZZ Spike' test flows in this app.

Case creation requires material, supplier, case contacts (Portal_Contact_Ids, Confirm_Contact_Ids, Supplier_Contact_Emails mandatory at Start), owner and due dates; the pinned Release row is copied in.
The BASIC section row is created only after the case submit succeeds.
CIQ RMM creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and both checks; after the K-FA test the basic-data step is assigned from Owner_RMM.

Every case step carries an SLA whose duration Beiersdorf sets; supplier waiting steps use the supplier due date and escalate to the owner; review steps have a reminder and an escalation (REQ-RMES-019).
Scope can be extended with a justification but never reduced; every scope run records additions only.
One CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section; N.A. sections get no row but stay in the scope run with their rule and answer.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L125; brd.md L986

business_rules.statement: A Part 2 branch runs only when Dept_<D>_Active = 'Yes'; the RMM branch is off by default; the case moves on only when every active branch is done (native join).
A department's Part 2 sign-off is blocked while it has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings — by the Workbench and by a native gate field on count fields.
Each Part 2 branch writes only its own 5–7 lane fields and no child tables; nobody else writes the case during Part 2 (contact changes via a Contact-update point, assignments via audit events).
'Open items check – before release request' and '– before close' run only if something is open (a blank count also holds); an override needs a reason and is audited.

Overall approval runs only if Overall_Approval_Required = 'Yes' (off by default); approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved; on rejection the case ends without a release request and a neutral closing text goes to the supplier.
'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' is skipped if overall-rejected; X5 sends the single release request (REQ-PROC-040); RMM can complete manually with a reason (REQ-PROC-045).

Cancellation: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects via the admin route; an audit Cancellation event is written; the case's open P2/P3 items are ended; the close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item (REQ-PROC-049). The same sweep runs after an overall rejection or a manual completion.
End of the case triggers Z1: PDF, e-mails to the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, notification log.

Case identity and material fields are plain scalars (Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No as Text that X1 reads); case contacts are fields, never a child table, because integrations can read only fields.
RMES_Key plus RMES_Created_At from Y4 are the case's single RMES record header (REQ-PROC-021).
After generate: Case Send-back off on every step and Reject only on RMM steps; Open Point Send-back only at review steps; Change Request Send-back and Reject off.
Raising an open point requires kind, owner department, to-supplier yes/no, reference, question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates (REQ-ADR-001).
Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed (REQ-PROC-036).
'Waiting for supplier' runs only when OP_To_Supplier = 'Yes'; internal kinds (Department review, Contact update, Internal review) skip it.
Exactly one review step runs, chosen by OP_Dept; only the owning department reviews the answer (REQ-PROC-034).

Review outcomes: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question/justification/due date written, answer cleared, Awaiting_Response = 'Yes', item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier').
Y3 approves 'Waiting for supplier' only while Awaiting_Response = 'Yes'.
Only the owning department writes the Rounds child table, at its own step.
App_Open_Point_Id means the point, not the round; each round still gets its own CIQP Query with its round number.
An additional part asks RMM (or the sync service) to create its CIQ Section row.
Change requests are created by Y6 from the portal (RMM by hand as fallback) and triaged by CIQ RMM, who checks the requester is a contact of the case.
A change attempt after PS-11 is refused and logged as an audit 'change attempt' event (REQ-PROC-043).
A change notice writes a new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows and a Department-review point is raised for each new section's lead department.
Each Assess branch runs only if Impact_<D> = 'Yes' and writes only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into that department's RMES sheet; the change request end sends X6 (CIQP Notice).
CIQ Supplier is written by CIQ RMM; Business Admin is Viewer unless BDF says otherwise; contact rows are written one at a time, re-read and merged.
A portal user serving two suppliers gets a contact row under each supplier.

CIQ Config Version is written by CIQ Business Admin as member without Delete (K-17); copy-on-write: publishing never edits a row; each publish writes an audit event; versions are downloadable (REQ-CFG-001/-003).
A Release row holds the full bundle plus hash so a pinned release never depends on rows that could change.
CIQ Section is written only by CIQ RMM and CIQ Integration Service; reviewers are Viewers.
K2.1 Components are rebuilt from the portal answers (read via sharing) whenever they change and once after the final release.
CIQ Scope Run rows are written by the session that ran the rules: RMM, or a department for an extension.
CIQ RMES Safety is written by Safety only; Regulatory can read but not edit it, and vice versa for CIQ RMES Regulatory (REQ-CFG-004).
One RMES row per case and department, created by the first session after PS-05 and keyed by RMES_Key; the Editing_By/Editing_Since lock allows only one writer at a time.
Every internal role writes CIQ Internal Note; the author edits only their own messages by convention; never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020).
CIQ Audit Event: recommended single writer CIQ Integration Service with every person Viewer; otherwise writers without Delete and the claim is 'tamper-evident' (REQ-CTL-009, REQ-CTL-010).
Never shared with the portal: department lanes and decisions, RMES, findings, internal notes, internal due dates, the overall decision, the audit trail.
Section answers and uploads are read from the portal through flow sharing, not copied.

forms.name: CIQ Audit Event
forms.description: Who did what and when, on which value and which document. Also notifications, delegations, assignments, section-review marks, scope, configuration, change attempts, cancellations, snapshots and item-created events.
forms.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L129, L285). Tamper-evident claim (A3 L66). Target of Z1/Z3/Z4 and source of Z2 (open questions Q1, Q5).

forms.name: CIQ Case
forms.description: One CIQ case cycle, from creation to the final PDF: supplier hand-offs, scope check, the parallel department review, optional overall approval and the single final release. Holds the material identity, the case contacts as fields, the six department lanes, the PS-05/PS-11 confirmations, the RMES header and the gate/hold counts.
forms.rationale: Moves between RMM, five departments in parallel and the Overall Approver through steps that carry SLAs: a Process (A1 L22; brd.md L119, L154-L194). Typed now because a Form can't gain a workflow later (LESSONS 1).
forms.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

forms.name: CIQ Change Request
forms.description: A change the supplier reports or requests (change notice, correction, attempt after the final release). RMM triages it, the affected departments assess it in parallel, and the supplier gets the outcome as a portal notice.
forms.rationale: Triage by RMM, then a parallel assessment by the impacted departments, each with an SLA: a Process (brd.md L121, L253-L272).
forms.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

forms.name: CIQ Config Version
forms.description: Every configuration version and kind (template, section definition, rule set, ownership, RMES criteria, limits, texts, reminders, settings), plus Release rows holding the full frozen bundle a case pins. Copy-on-write.
forms.rationale: Stored data with no steps (no four-eyes, A3 L65): a Data Form (brd.md L123, L279). CIQ Config Release is folded into Release rows (L136).

forms.name: CIQ Internal Note
forms.description: Internal chat, one message per row. Never visible to suppliers.
forms.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L128, L284). One row per message because many people post at any time (L337, C2).

forms.name: CIQ Open Point
forms.description: One question, document request or additional part to the supplier, with every back-and-forth round inside the same item. Also the internal kinds Department review, Contact update and Internal review, which skip the supplier step.
forms.rationale: Raised by a department, waits for the supplier, then reviewed by exactly one owning department, with SLAs on each step: a Process (brd.md L120, L222-L247). Its own item, not a case child table: six departments raise points at the same time in Part 2 (L328, C2/C3).
forms.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

forms.name: CIQ RMES Regulatory
forms.description: Regulatory's RMES sheet for one case; same shape as CIQ RMES Safety.
forms.rationale: As CIQ RMES Safety, for Regulatory (brd.md L127, L283, L331).

forms.name: CIQ RMES Safety
forms.description: Safety's RMES sheet for one case: all criteria and findings in one row, with header counts that feed the case gate and an edit lock.
forms.rationale: Working data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L126, L282). A separate Form from Regulatory so Safety and Regulatory can't edit each other (REQ-CFG-004, L331, C4).

forms.name: CIQ Scope Run
forms.description: One run of the scope rules (initial, extension, change notice, additional part, reactivation), with every section's classification including N.A. and the rule and answer behind it. Additions only.
forms.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L125, L281). Own rows: runs come from different people at different times (L334, C3).

forms.name: CIQ Section
forms.description: One released section of a case: what was released, why, and for which department. The app twin of the portal section. The K2.1 row carries the component list; K2.1 and BASIC rows carry the search mirrors.
forms.rationale: Written once per release and later by the component rebuild, with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L124, L280). Own rows, not a case child table: each row fires X2 and rows are added when RMM holds no case step (L333, C1/C3).

forms.name: CIQ Supplier
forms.description: One supplier company with its people. Supplier_Code is the isolation key on every portal item.
forms.rationale: Master data with no routing: a Data Form (A1 L23; brd.md L122, L278). Contacts are a child table: one writer, small, parent mirrors cover search (L329).

data_scope.rule: All internal roles read all records of every flow they are granted (scope 'all'); v4 defines no record-level isolation for Beiersdorf roles. 'Own lane' on the case and 'own department' on open points are enforced by step ownership and branch-scoped field permissions, not by a row filter. CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation is by write grant only (the other department reads, REQ-CFG-004). Future views/dashboards (Workbench) must reuse this map.

hard_rules.rule: No pages (--no-pages). Any native page/card on a flow auto-grants its target roles as editors and would break every V cell, in particular CIQ RMES Safety/Regulatory isolation (REQ-CFG-004) and the read-only CIQ Reader.
CIQ Case Admin members must also hold CIQ RMM; Case Admin carries only flow Admin on the three Processes, View on Forms, and write on CIQ Internal Note and CIQ Audit Event.
The supplier has no app role and no grant; portal flows (CIQP *) are never granted here.
CIQ Integration Service never acts on a human step after Start; it initiates CIQ Change Request (Y6) only and writes CIQ Section and CIQ Audit Event rows.
Child tables are keyed at TABLE level only in step permissions; every header field and child table is keyed explicitly at every task step (unlisted = ReadOnly).

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Audit Event is written by people (Q3 default), so the claim is 'tamper-evident', not immutable. Until K-17 proves a Form member without Delete, the engine's Editable Form grant may include Delete.
residual_risks.mitigation: Post-generate REST reset to no-Delete; hash chain per A3 L66; the single-writer option (service only) stays available if BDF wants immutability.

residual_risks.risk: Step-owning roles (5 Reviewers on CIQ Case and CIQ Change Request, CIQ Overall Approver on CIQ Case) come out of generate with InitiateItems and can raise items natively until the REST reset.
residual_risks.mitigation: post_generate_grants; the Workbench hides '+ New' for them.

residual_risks.risk: CIQ Open Point Start is Act for RMM and all five Reviewers (v4 L237); the engine assigns the start step's owner as ciq_rmm. Any Reviewer can raise for any department; the owning department is a field (OP_Dept), not a grant.
residual_risks.mitigation: Workbench preselects OP_Dept from the raiser's role; review step ownership (OPNT_R_<D>) enforces 'only the owning department reviews' (REQ-PROC-034).

residual_risks.risk: Form grants are per Form (C4): every CIQ Scope Run / CIQ Internal Note writer can edit every row, including other departments' runs and other authors' notes.
residual_risks.mitigation: Convention (v4 L284 'by convention') plus F8 audit events.

residual_risks.risk: Conformance #3: a Form grant does not carry its child table (the compiled parent FlowPermission has no column entry for Contacts/Components/Criteria/Findings). The security IR accepts a grant keyed on the child-table id and compiles a separate FlowPermission on that child model, so each child table now mirrors its parent Form cell. Whether the platform applies a member grant on a child model, and whether it is what lets a non-admin write rows, is [unverified, K-17].
residual_risks.mitigation: K-17 acceptance test: as a non-admin CIQ RMM user add/edit/delete a Contacts row on a CIQ Supplier item; as CIQ Safety Reviewer add a Criteria and a Findings row on CIQ RMES Safety; as CIQ Regulatory Reviewer try the same on CIQ RMES Safety (must be refused) and on CIQ RMES Regulatory (must succeed); as CIQ Reader confirm rows are visible and read-only. If generate rejects a child-model grant, drop those 61 grants (Forms stay editable after publish) and grant the child-table column on the parent over REST.

residual_risks.risk: Step-level Mandatory on formula fields (Start_Gate, <D>_Gate, Open_Items_Gate) blocks submit while a count is blank; this is intended (A2 L34) but a native My Tasks user without the Workbench must write the counts by hand.
